publication.note: Public release. Data reuse clearance confirmed by the project owner on 2026-10-24.

sources.label: BBall Index LEBRON and WAR via Fanspo

definitions.salary: Fanspo-reported historical season salary. One year uses nominal dollars; multi-year views average annual salary cap shares and show end-season cap-equivalent dollars. These are not independently verified cash payments.
definitions.eligibility: At least 200 total minutes and 5 games across the selected observed active seasons, with complete comparable salary and metric inputs in every such season. This operational rule does not guarantee individual-score reliability.
definitions.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% whole-player case-bootstrap SE intervals, conditional on fixed provider scores, matched sample, exposure rules, representation and selected model family. These are not individual impact intervals, causal effects, simultaneous bands or full post-selection coverage. Unresolved intervals are withheld.
limitations: Salary and team filters preserve the full eligible league reference and support counts.
An extra $1m is an association with contribution, not a causal purchase. Multi-year contrasts mean an extra $1m in average annual end-season cap-equivalent salary.
WAR includes availability. Multi-year WAR is an average across observed matched active seasons; fully absent seasons are not imputed as zero.
Provider tTmPoss weights rate averages; its exact possession convention is not owner-documented. Provider-score uncertainty is unavailable.
Missing, zero-placeholder and multiple-record salaries remain unresolved. The matched sample is not the entire NBA or team payroll.
Bootstrap resampling cannot recover dependence from jointly estimated provider ratings or shared team environments.

coverage.note: 374 of 431 exposure-eligible players have complete matched inputs. Salary coverage uses known comparable amounts only; 125 active player-season salaries are unknown. This is not whole-league or whole-payroll efficiency.

lebron.name: Straight line
lebron.method: Equal-player fit; intercept/linear/cr-GAM k=5; training-only REML; one-SE and fixed second-partition stability rule. Filters preserve this league reference.
lebron.validation: Seed 20261023: intercept MSE 3.174; linear MSE 1.9632; smooth MSE 1.9645; one-SE choice linear | Seed 20261024: intercept MSE 3.1914; linear MSE 1.9566; smooth MSE 1.9683; one-SE choice linear | Final choice: linear | Bootstrap: 499/499 valid; seed 20463336 | Interval status: computed_conditional_intervals
lebron.intervalLabel: 95% pointwise normal-approximation whole-player case-bootstrap SE; conditional on fixed provider scores, cohort and selected family
